question: Does a source-bound 1937 printed edition of 《文淵閣書目》 directly preserve the Zhunzhai title as 九漏新式, and what may that safely prove about the 九/几 variant?
answer: YES AT THE 1937 PRINTED RECEIVED-TEXT LAYER ONLY. DIRECT NO-OCR REVIEW OF PDF P194 READS 準齋九漏新式一部一冊完全 BETWEEN 官歷漏刻圖 AND 年日月通用. THIS DIRECTLY CONFIRMS 九漏 IN A SECOND, LATER PRINTED WENYUANGE RECENSION/SURFACE AND MAKES THE 1799 九漏 READING NON-OCR-DEPENDENT. IT DOES NOT CREATE A SECOND INDEPENDENT 1441 WITNESS, DOES NOT DATE THE ORIGINAL ZHUNZHAI WORK, DOES NOT PROVE 九 IS ORIGINAL AGAINST 1605 几, DOES NOT CLOSE TITLE-STATE IDENTITY, PRE-1578 25-ARROW PROSE, OR SANMING PARENTAGE.
